title: 第285章 世界守护者第284章 泰伦世界的实力
slug: 穿越自带炼妖壶桀桀顷刻炼化
content_zh:
罗恩估计，泰伦世界人类所有的三级战力加起来，应该快到一千了。
半神也得有三四十。
这都是得益于世界晋升的原因。
上限被拔高，下面的路也会好走不少，原本那些被卡住境界的老家伙。
以后都会陆续突破。
估计再过个几十年，这个数字还能长一半。
罗恩把目光从那些中小公国身上收回来，重新落回中央圆桌。
真正决定这次会议走向的，还得是那几个站在金字塔尖上的势力。
圆桌上的席位不多，只有寥寥六七人。
都是几大势力中的掌权者，如女帝阿尔托莉雅、荣耀首相等。
不过中间空着四个空位。
看样子应该是那三位世界之主的位置。
最后剩下那个罗恩也有猜测：“不会是给那个世界守护者的吧？
奶奶的，都没看见我这个世界之子吗？
真是瞎了你们的狗眼！”
对于这种赤裸裸的歧视，罗恩心中很不爽。
这让他对于那个素未谋面的世界守护者，也多了一分不爽。
但这份不爽还没持续多大会。
那几位世界之主就姗姗来迟了，后面还跟着一位少女。
几位世界之主罗恩都见过，这次还是老样子。

三人特色明显，古德里安像一个学识渊博的学者，星辰之心犹如温暖的太阳让人心生好感。
最后的荣耀皇帝德拉肯则是锋芒毕露，让人根本不敢与之对视。
几人气质各异，但都有一个共同的特点。
那就是站在那里，你都能感受到对方身上的气势深不见底。
而他们身后的那位少女就不一样了。
少女一袭白袍曳地，及腰长发是通透柔和的水蓝色，恰似拂晓无风的湖面，清浅碧波顺着发丝缓缓流淌。
她眉眼柔和，浑身没有一点凌人的意味，透着不染尘嚣的温润澄澈。
明明只是三阶实力，但在站在几个世界之主跟前，居然让人怎么都无法忽视。
甚至她身上透露出来的气息，还有种让人天然想依赖的感觉。
罗恩第一时间就想叫“妈妈！”了。
这少女还有一点让人不可忽视的就是，她身边还飞着一只两米多大的雏龙。
这只龙和泰伦世界现有的金属龙全都不一样。
通体是由蓝宝石构成的，并且散发着不同寻常的魔力波动。
众人把目光看向这头龙，脑海里都不由蹦出来几个字——魔力蓝宝石龙
同时也都在心里暗暗猜测，这位少女到底是什么来头。
content_en:
Ron estimated that the combined third-level combat power of all humans in the Tyrannic world should be close to one thousand.
Demigods also have to be thirty or forty.
This is all due to the promotion of the world.
The upper limit has been raised, and the road below will be much easier for those old guys who were stuck in the realm.
There will be breakthroughs one after another in the future.
It is estimated that in a few decades, this number will be half as high.
Ron withdrew his gaze from the small and medium-sized principalities and returned to the central round table.
What really determines the direction of this meeting is the few forces standing at the top of the pyramid.
There were not many seats at the round table, only six or seven people.
They are all powerful people in several major forces, such as Empress Artoria, Prime Minister of Glory, etc.
But there are four empty seats in the middle.
It seems that it should be the position of the three world lords.
The last remaining one, Ron, also had a guess: "Isn't it for the guardian of the world?
Grandma, haven’t you seen me, the son of this world?
It's really blinding your dog eyes! "
Ron was very unhappy with this kind of blatant discrimination.
This made him feel even more unhappy about the guardian of the world he had never met before.
But this dissatisfaction did not last long.
The Lords of the World arrived belatedly, followed by a young girl.
Ron, the Lord of the Worlds, has seen it before, but this time it’s still the same.
The three people have obvious characteristics. Guderian is like a knowledgeable scholar, and the heart of the stars is like the warm sun that makes people feel good.
The last glorious emperor, Drakken, was so sharp that no one dared to look at him.
Several people have different temperaments, but they all have a common characteristic.
That is, standing there, you can feel the bottomless momentum of the other person.
But the girl behind them was different.
The girl wears a white robe that touches the floor. Her waist-length hair is a transparent and soft aqua blue, just like the windless lake surface at dawn, with clear blue waves flowing slowly along her hair.
Her eyebrows were soft, and there was no overbearing connotation in her body. She exuded a gentleness and clarity that was not stained by the hustle and bustle of the world.
He was obviously only at the third level of strength, but standing in front of several world lords, he was impossible to ignore.
Even the aura radiating from her body has a feeling that people naturally want to rely on.
Ron immediately wanted to call "Mom!"
Another thing about this girl that cannot be ignored is that there is a two-meter-sized baby dragon flying next to her.
This dragon is completely different from the existing metal dragons in the Tyranid world.
The entire body is made of sapphire and exudes unusual magic fluctuations.
Everyone looked at the dragon, and a few words popped into their minds - Magic Sapphire Dragon
At the same time, they all secretly guessed in their hearts what the background of this girl was.
